note: Sung & Adve (DeNovoSync, ASPLOS 2015) adopt the standard C++/Java data-race-free memory model, which defines sequentially consistent semantics for data-race-free programs (SC is used as the correctness criterion for synchronization accesses), so on the race-free fragment it admits exactly the SC outcomes. It extends DeNovo to arbitrary synchronization while keeping this SC-for-DRF contract.
